findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0233: Hardcoded HTTP URLs
findings.explanation:
Server selection falls back to a plain http:// URL when the https check fails.
app/src/main/java/com/nextcloud/talk/account/ServerSelectionActivity.kt:264: https URL is rewritten to http:// and queried.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0235: Android App Configurations Allowing Cleartext Traffic
findings.explanation:
The network security config's base-config permits cleartext traffic for every domain.
app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml:10: base-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="true"

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0285: Outdated Android Version Allowing Trust in User-Provided CAs
findings.explanation:
The network security config trusts user-installed CAs outside debug-overrides, so anyone who can install a certificate on the device can read the app's TLS traffic.
app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml:14: base-config trusts user-installed CAs

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0242: Missing Certificate Pinning in Network Security Configuration
findings.explanation:
No pin-set in a network security config. Pinning may be done in code (OkHttp CertificatePinner, a custom TrustManager), which Ward doesn't read. MASVS L2 expects pinning; L1 doesn't.
app/src/gplay/AndroidManifest.xml:18: networkSecurityConfig @xml/network_security_config
